description: Streams raw_games rows for a run and source without materializing the whole result set in memory, since a run's bulk catalog snapshot can be on the order of 150k rows.
signature: def read_raw_payloads(conn: sqlite3.Connection, run_id: str, source: str) -> Iterator[RawPayload]
docstring:
Stream raw payloads for one source.

Args:
    conn: An open connection.
    run_id: The run to read.
    source: One of 'steamspy_all','steamspy_appdetails','steam_appdetails','steam_reviews'.

Yields:
    RawPayload instances, one per matching row, in an unspecified but stable-for-a-given-run order (typically appid ascending, via the idx_raw_games_run_source index).

Raises:
    StorageError: If source is not one of the four allowed values.
postconditions: The underlying cursor is consumed incrementally (server-side cursor / fetchmany batches), so peak memory does not scale with the full 150k-row bulk snapshot
Yields zero items, not an error, for a run/source combination with no rows

edge_cases.expected_behavior: yields nothing; the iterator is simply empty

edge_cases.input: source not one of the four allowed values
edge_cases.expected_behavior: StorageError raised immediately (before any iteration), not lazily on first next()

edge_cases.input: Caller only consumes the first few items and abandons the iterator
edge_cases.expected_behavior: no resource leak; the underlying cursor is closed via a context manager / generator cleanup (try/finally)

unit_tests.name: test_streams_all_matching_rows
unit_tests.description: A fixture with 3 steamspy_all rows and 2 steam_appdetails rows for the run yields exactly the 3 matching rows when source='steamspy_all'.

unit_tests.name: test_empty_result_yields_nothing
unit_tests.description: A source with no rows yields an empty iterator.

unit_tests.name: test_invalid_source_raises_immediately
unit_tests.description: An invalid source string raises StorageError before iteration begins.
